answer: An address may attest only after locking 50 POA for eight epochs, and that bond is returned only once five of its answers have peer seals plus a uniqueness audit. Every submitted text is shingled into a public 5-gram index. If Jaccard similarity with any other address over the last 12 epochs exceeds 0.30, the later bond is burned and the earlier bond is frozen pending audit. A tide of aliases therefore costs 50 POA each, and a shared draft is a total loss. This lock is not a velvet courtesy for newcomers. A violet slash flag stays on the ledger so later panels can refuse the whole cluster.
